property_summary: For every input where the _tos array is non-empty, C.transfer(...) always returns (does not revert) and makes exactly N external calls to the callee (one per _tos entry) — the mutant inverts the length check causing calls with non-empty _tos to revert or not call the callee, so there exists a non-empty _tos that the mutant rejects while the reference accepts and performs the calls.
change_summary: Change the require that _tos.length > 0 to require _tos.length == 0 so calls with non-empty _tos revert and empty _tos succeed (opposite behavior).
